tr.name: Paty: Retro Evcil Hayvan
tr.subtitle: Besle, yıka, oyna, kaybetme!
tr.promotionalText: Barınağa nadir bir Sfenks kedisi geldi! Retro piksel evinde dostlarını besle, yıka, sev. İhmal edersen kapıdan kaçarlar, 24 saatte bulman gerekir.
tr.description:
Paty, retro piksel dünyasında geçen bir evcil hayvan oyunu. Barınaktan ilk dostunu sahiplen, ona bir isim ver ve evini birlikte kur.

DOSTLARIN SENİ BEKLİYOR
Zaman gerçek saatle akar, sen yokken de. Dostların acıkır, kirlenir, uykuları gelir. Besle, yıka, oyna, sev. Her birinin kendi huyu var: nazlı, obur, uykucu, meraklı...

FLIX HEP YANINDA
Rehberin Flix odaya yürüyerek gelir. Besle dersen mamayı o koyar, Yıka dersen süngeriyle gelir, Oyna dersen top atar. Bir dostun mutsuzsa ilk o haber verir.

İHMAL EDERSEN KAÇARLAR
Uzun süre ilgisiz kalan dost kapıya bakmaya başlar, sonra çekip gider. Kapıya kayıp ilanı asılır ve onu 24 saat içinde mahallede araman gerekir. Bulamazsan anısı duvarda kalır.

BARINAKTA NADİR CİNSLER
Barınağa her gün yeni dostlar gelir. Tekir, Golden ve Hollanda tavşanı sık görülür; Sfenks, Husky, Siyam nadirdir; Van kedisi, Dalmaçyalı ve Ara papağanı efsanevidir. Nadir biri gelince Flix haber verir.

KEDİ, KÖPEK VE FAZLASI
Seviye atladıkça hamster, akvaryum balıkları, kafeste uçan muhabbet kuşları, tavşan ve sincap gelir. Egzotik dükkanda kirpi, fennek tilkisi, bukalemun, tarantula, mısır yılanı, bambu köpek balığı ve kızıl panda seni bekler.

EVİNİ BÜYÜT
Salon, akvaryum, teraryum, kuş kafesi ve bahçe. Oyuncaklar al: koşu çarkı, tırmalama direği, Flix peluş... Dostların birbiriyle oynar, bazen de kavga eder.

HER GÜN YENİ GÖREVLER
Günlük görevleri tamamla, Flix Topu mini oyununda rekor kır, altın ve elmas kazan.

Türkçe, İngilizce, Arapça, Fransızca, Almanca ve İspanyolca oynanabilir.

Oyun ücretsizdir. İsteğe bağlı uygulama içi satın almalar (elmas paketleri, Reklamsız) ve reklamlar içerir. İnternet olmadan da oynanır.
tr.reviewNotes:
Paty is a single-player virtual pet game. No account or login is needed.

HOW TO TEST:
1. Tap Başla (Start). Flix, the guide, walks in and runs a short tutorial: adopt a cat or a dog at the shelter, then Besle (Feed), pet it, Oyna (Play) and buy a first toy in Mağaza (Shop).
2. In-app purchases: Mağaza (Shop) > Elmas paketleri (Gem packs). Gems are consumable (paty_gems_50 / 120 / 300); 'Reklamsız' (paty_noads) is non-consumable and removes interstitial ads. 'Satın alımları geri yükle' (Restore Purchases) is in the gem store and in Ayarlar (Settings).
3. Gems are spent in Mağaza > Egzotik dükkan (exotic pets, unlocks at player level 4). Every level-up and every daily task also gives gems for free.
4. Ads (Google AdMob): a rewarded ad only when the player taps 'Reklam izle' in the shop or for an extra try in the search mini-game; occasional interstitials only after a mini-game ends, never during the tutorial. Google's consent message (EEA/UK/CH) is shown first, then Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt, then ads start. 'Gizlilik Seçenekleri' (Privacy Options) appears in Settings where Google requires it.
5. Local notifications are optional and only requested after the tutorial, with an explanation first.
6. The game simulates real time. A hidden tester panel (tap the version text in Settings 7 times) can speed time up; it cannot grant coins or gems.

The game is in Turkish by default; English and four other languages can be chosen on the title screen or in Ayarlar (Settings) > Dil / Language.

en-US.name: Paty: Retro Pixel Pets
en-US.subtitle: Feed, wash, play, don't lose!
en-US.promotionalText: A rare Sphynx cat just arrived at the shelter! Feed, wash and cuddle your buddies in a retro pixel home. Neglect them and they run away.
en-US.description:
Paty is a virtual pet game in a retro pixel world. Adopt your first buddy at the shelter, give it a name and build a home together.

YOUR BUDDIES ARE WAITING
Time passes in real time, even while you are away. Your pets get hungry, dirty and sleepy. Feed, wash, play and cuddle. Each one has its own personality: picky, greedy, sleepy, curious...

FLIX IS ALWAYS THERE
Your guide Flix walks into the room. Tap Feed and he fills the bowl, tap Wash and he comes with a sponge, tap Play and he throws a ball. If a buddy is unhappy, he tells you first.

NEGLECT THEM AND THEY RUN
A buddy left alone too long starts staring at the door, then leaves. A lost poster goes up and you have 24 hours to search the neighbourhood.

RARE BREEDS AT THE SHELTER
New buddies arrive every day. Some are common, Sphynx, Husky and Siamese are rare, and the Van cat, Dalmatian and Macaw are legendary. Flix lets you know when a rare one shows up.

CATS, DOGS AND MORE
Level up to meet hamsters, aquarium fish, budgies that fly around the room, rabbits and squirrels. The Exotic shop has a hedgehog, fennec fox, chameleon, tarantula, corn snake, bamboo shark and red panda.

GROW YOUR HOME
Living room, aquarium, terrarium, bird cage and garden. Buy toys and watch your pets play together, or squabble.

Available in English, Turkish, Arabic, French, German and Spanish.

Free to play. Contains optional in-app purchases (gem packs, No Ads) and ads. Plays offline.

ar-SA.name: Paty: حيوانات بكسل
ar-SA.subtitle: أطعم، اغسل، العب، لا تفقده!
ar-SA.promotionalText: وصل قط سفينكس نادر إلى الملجأ! أطعم أصدقاءك واغسلهم ودلّلهم في بيت بكسل كلاسيكي. إن أهملتهم سيهربون.
ar-SA.description:
Paty لعبة حيوانات أليفة افتراضية في عالم بكسل كلاسيكي. تبنَّ صديقك الأول من الملجأ، وأعطه اسمًا، وابنيا بيتكما معًا.

أصدقاؤك بانتظارك
الوقت يمضي فعليًا حتى في غيابك. تجوع حيواناتك وتتسخ وتنعس. أطعمها واغسلها والعب معها ودلّلها. لكل منها طبعه الخاص.

فليكس دائمًا معك
يدخل دليلك فليكس إلى الغرفة: اضغط أطعم فيملأ الوعاء، واضغط اغسل فيأتي بالإسفنجة، واضغط العب فيرمي الكرة.

إن أهملتهم يهربون
الحيوان المهمل طويلًا يحدّق في الباب ثم يرحل. أمامك 24 ساعة للبحث عنه في الحي.

سلالات نادرة في الملجأ
يصل أصدقاء جدد كل يوم، وبعضهم نادر أو أسطوري مثل قط فان والدلماسي وببغاء المكاو.

قطط وكلاب وأكثر
مع ارتفاع مستواك تصل الهامستر والأسماك والطيور والأرانب والسناجب. وفي متجر الحيوانات الغريبة: قنفذ، ثعلب الفنك، حرباء، رتيلاء، ثعبان الذرة، قرش الخيزران والباندا الحمراء.

متاحة بالعربية والإنجليزية والتركية والفرنسية والألمانية والإسبانية.

اللعبة مجانية وتحتوي على مشتريات اختيارية (حزم الجواهر، بلا إعلانات) وإعلانات. تعمل دون إنترنت.

fr-FR.name: Paty : Animaux Pixel Rétro
fr-FR.subtitle: Nourris, lave, joue, câline !
fr-FR.promotionalText: Un chat Sphynx rare vient d'arriver au refuge ! Nourris, lave et câline tes compagnons dans une maison pixel rétro. Négligés, ils s'enfuient.
fr-FR.description:
Paty est un jeu d'animal virtuel dans un monde pixel rétro. Adopte ton premier compagnon au refuge, donne-lui un nom et construisez votre maison ensemble.

TES COMPAGNONS T'ATTENDENT
Le temps passe en vrai, même quand tu es absent. Tes animaux ont faim, se salissent, ont sommeil. Nourris, lave, joue et câline. Chacun a son caractère.

FLIX EST TOUJOURS LÀ
Ton guide Flix entre dans la pièce : Nourrir, il remplit la gamelle ; Laver, il arrive avec l'éponge ; Jouer, il lance la balle.

NÉGLIGÉS, ILS S'ENFUIENT
Un animal laissé seul trop longtemps fixe la porte, puis s'en va. Tu as 24 heures pour fouiller le quartier.

DES RACES RARES AU REFUGE
De nouveaux compagnons arrivent chaque jour, dont des rares et des légendaires comme le chat de Van, le dalmatien ou l'ara.

CHATS, CHIENS ET PLUS
En montant de niveau : hamsters, poissons, perruches, lapins et écureuils. À la boutique exotique : hérisson, fennec, caméléon, mygale, serpent des blés, requin-bambou et panda roux.

Disponible en français, anglais, turc, arabe, allemand et espagnol.

Gratuit. Contient des achats intégrés facultatifs (packs de gemmes, Sans pub) et des publicités. Fonctionne hors ligne.

de-DE.name: Paty: Retro Pixel Tiere
de-DE.subtitle: Füttern, waschen, kuscheln!
de-DE.promotionalText: Eine seltene Sphynx-Katze ist im Tierheim! Füttere, wasche und kuschle deine Freunde in einem Retro-Pixel-Zuhause. Vernachlässigt laufen sie weg.
de-DE.description:
Paty ist ein virtuelles Haustierspiel in einer Retro-Pixelwelt. Adoptiere deinen ersten Freund im Tierheim, gib ihm einen Namen und baut gemeinsam euer Zuhause.

DEINE FREUNDE WARTEN
Die Zeit läuft in Echtzeit, auch wenn du weg bist. Deine Tiere bekommen Hunger, werden schmutzig und müde. Füttern, waschen, spielen, kuscheln. Jedes hat seinen eigenen Charakter.

FLIX IST IMMER DA
Dein Begleiter Flix kommt ins Zimmer: Bei Füttern füllt er den Napf, bei Waschen kommt er mit dem Schwamm, bei Spielen wirft er den Ball.

VERNACHLÄSSIGT LAUFEN SIE WEG
Ein zu lange allein gelassenes Tier starrt zur Tür und geht. Du hast 24 Stunden, um die Nachbarschaft abzusuchen.

SELTENE RASSEN IM TIERHEIM
Täglich kommen neue Freunde, darunter seltene und legendäre wie die Van-Katze, der Dalmatiner oder der Ara.

KATZEN, HUNDE UND MEHR
Mit höherem Level: Hamster, Fische, Wellensittiche, Hasen und Eichhörnchen. Im Exotenladen: Igel, Wüstenfuchs, Chamäleon, Vogelspinne, Kornnatter, Bambushai und Roter Panda.

Auf Deutsch, Englisch, Türkisch, Arabisch, Französisch und Spanisch.

Kostenlos. Enthält optionale In-App-Käufe (Edelsteinpakete, Werbefrei) und Werbung. Spielbar offline.

es-ES.name: Paty: Mascotas Pixel Retro
es-ES.subtitle: Alimenta, baña, juega, mima
es-ES.promotionalText: ¡Ha llegado un gato esfinge raro al refugio! Alimenta, baña y mima a tus amigos en una casa pixel retro. Si los descuidas, se escapan.
es-ES.description:
Paty es un juego de mascotas virtuales en un mundo pixel retro. Adopta a tu primer amigo en el refugio, ponle nombre y construid juntos vuestro hogar.

TUS AMIGOS TE ESPERAN
El tiempo pasa de verdad, incluso cuando no estás. Tus mascotas tienen hambre, se ensucian y les entra sueño. Aliméntalas, báñalas, juega y mímalas. Cada una tiene su carácter.

FLIX SIEMPRE ESTÁ AHÍ
Tu guía Flix entra en la habitación: Alimentar y llena el cuenco, Bañar y llega con la esponja, Jugar y lanza la pelota.

SI LOS DESCUIDAS, SE ESCAPAN
Una mascota sola demasiado tiempo mira la puerta y se va. Tendrás 24 horas para buscarla por el barrio.

RAZAS RARAS EN EL REFUGIO
Cada día llegan amigos nuevos, algunos raros y legendarios como el gato de Van, el dálmata o el guacamayo.

GATOS, PERROS Y MÁS
Al subir de nivel: hámsters, peces, periquitos, conejos y ardillas. En la tienda exótica: erizo, zorro fénec, camaleón, tarántula, serpiente del maíz, tiburón bambú y panda rojo.

Disponible en español, inglés, turco, árabe, francés y alemán.

Gratis. Incluye compras opcionales (packs de gemas, Sin anuncios) y anuncios. Se juega sin conexión.

iapReviewNote: Open Mağaza (Shop) > Elmas paketleri (Gem packs). Gems are spent in Mağaza > Egzotik dükkan. 'Reklamsız' removes interstitial ads and can be restored with 'Satın alımları geri yükle'.

testflight.description: Paty: retro pixel virtual pet game by Flix Toys. Try the tutorial, adopt pets, test purchases with a Sandbox account.
